transcript.text: Last May I was in Shenzhen for a couple days, and I remember we kept chatting about how many good places there are to eat around there.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That same trip, my coworker was also browsing what shows were on in Shenzhen at the time, just to see what was happening in town.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We ended up at Din Tai Fung Shenzhen—Mason White had put the reservation under his name, and it was for 6 people.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still have the screenshot: it was dated 2025-05-24 and the time on it was 14:00.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: His contact number on the booking details was 13856781234, which made it easy when the restaurant called to confirm.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and for the event side of that trip—Zhang Wei had already gotten a ticket for the Tech Innovation Forum, one VIP seat, and it was just 1 ticket; the phone on that purchase was 13892862812.
